public.text: Defining what is covered, for whom, and under which conditions may combine three separate concerns: benefit definitions, scheme definitions, and beneficiary eligibility. The Benefits Package Registry should not become an operational eligibility or enrolment system.
public.suggestedRevision: Limit the component to authoritative definitions and rules. State that enrolment, beneficiary records, real-time eligibility determination, contracting, authorisation, claims adjudication, and payment remain operational capabilities.
